launches.title: Agentin AI – AI Agents to Automate Quote-to-Cash
launches.tagline: Our AI Agents connect with Salesforce, NetSuite and SAP to automate order processing, invoicing and payments, cutting QTC from weeks to minutes.
launches.body:
[Watch our AI Agents in action:](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWOc8s5bjyY)

**TL;DR:** Agentin AI builds AI Agents that automate the entire Quote-to-Cash (QTC) workflow by connecting with enterprise systems like Salesforce, NetSuite, and SAP. We eliminate incomplete orders, mismatched data and delayed payments, cutting down QTC from weeks to minutes and boosting cash flow. [Here's a quick podcast overview.](https://open.spotify.com/episode/2hKTVSOJS7aFpSJR16v1dt)

**What is Quote-to-Cash (QTC)?** Quote to Cash is the full business process from receiving customer orders through fulfillment, invoicing, payment collection, and reconciliation.

**Why this matters:** Slow or inefficient QTC processes directly delay cash flow, add operational overhead, and limit business growth.

**The Problem:** Companies dealing with high order volumes typically struggle with:

* **Incomplete Orders:** Missing details cause delays.
* **Mismatched Data:** Manual errors create reconciliation headaches.
* **Delayed Payments:** Inefficient processes slow down cash collections.

These issues often extend QTC from days to weeks, impacting revenue and productivity.

**Our Solution:** Agentin AI’s Agents connect with existing enterprise CRM and ERP systems to:

* **Automate Data Entry:** Remove manual input, reducing errors.
* **Ensure Data Consistency:** Detect and fix data mismatches automatically.
* **Accelerate Payments:** Speed up invoicing and reconciliation, cutting QTC time from weeks to minutes.

**Backstory:** I am Sankeerth Rao Karingula, founder of Agentin AI (YC W25) and an ex-Google Research Scientist. At Agentin AI, we develop reinforcement learning algorithms so our AI Agents can learn and adapt from failures. After seeing how manual QTC processes slow businesses down, I built Agentin AI to solve these inefficiencies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88196&key=user_uploads/423828/a3e2119a-1948-4ce1-8abc-09ce48991a91)

**Our Ask:**

* Could you introduce us to finance or ops leaders at companies with $100M+ in revenue and handling 1,000+ orders per month?
* If your organization faces manual QTC challenges, schedule a demo at [agentin.ai](https://www.agentin.ai/) or contact me at [sankeerthrao@agentin.ai](mailto:sankeerthrao@agentin.ai).

Thank you! We’re dedicated to automating away manual Quote-to-Cash inefficiencies so teams can focus on higher-value tasks.
